description: TY2025: the SS 219(g)(2)(B) $200 floor. Single, covered, $88,900 wages ($100 from the phase-out end), $7,000 contributed. Excess 9,900 of 10,000 -> reduction floor10(7,000 x 0.99 = 6,930) = 6,930 -> reduced limit $70, which is below $200 but not zero -> the statute floors it at $200. Deduction $200. TI = 88,900 - 200 - 15,750 = 72,950 -> Table midpoint 72,975: 1,192.50+4,386+22%x24,500=5,390 -> 10,968.50 -> $10,969 (half-up). Net $10,969.00.
